📣 🧪 **ACDT #105, Mon Nov 30, 14:00 UTC** Please add comments and come prepared 😸 
https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2320

EL teams: The EL breakout will mainly focus on `bogota-devnet-3` scope and has two big items.

1. **Frames design (EIP-8141): How PQ signatures/claims are carried.** There are 3 candidates: Please check:
  - The [ACDT agenda](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2320) for an overview,
  - [ethereum/execution-specs#4069](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/4069), the bogota-devnet-3 test release tracking issue, for a side-by-side comparison.
  - This thread in <#1569690395095470130> to stay up with the current state (potential update incoming): https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1575453480171208704

**2. EIP scope: keep the devnet-2 list or extend it?** Candidates: EIP-8360 TCREATE (alongside EIP-4758), EIP-7668, EIP-3298. Heads-up: EIP-8298 SETCODEFROM is expected to change in a breaking way vs devnet-2 (<https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12716>).

Please comment here or add relevant discussion points to the agenda! In particular for the CL breakout, thanks!
